Requirements already extracted and implemented in lichen/timing/sfn.py:

MUST requirements from spec section 14.7:
1. All nodes MUST compute TDMA slot using identical hash (FNV-1a 32-bit per spec 4.5) - hash_32()
2. Nodes MUST NOT use implementation-specific variations - standard FNV-1a
3. Slot index MUST be (hash_32(eui64) + sfn) mod num_slots - slot_for()
4. Nodes MUST reject SFN updates unless timestamp passes epoch floor validation - DesyncFSM.on_sfn_wrap() checks time_valid
5. Implementations MUST implement Desynchronization Recovery FSM - DesyncFSM with SYNCED/DESYNCED/RECOVERING states
6. SFN delta MUST use unsigned 32-bit arithmetic - sfn_delta() with bitmask

RECOMMENDED: 3 superframes timeout for RECOVERING - implemented in on_beacon()

All requirements covered by existing tests in test_sfn.py.
